item.title: Prince’s former Beverly Park estate gets $13.5M price cut
item.description: The sprawling estate at 77 Beverly Park Lane is listed for $54.5 million after a significant price cut. It features nine bedrooms, 15 bathrooms, and a private theatre for entertaining guests comfortably. The property was previously owned by developer George Santopietro and boasted historical significance due to Prince's residency. The landscaping showcases resort-style grounds designed by a renowned landscape designer.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: Texas woman who worked as school janitor for 39 years gets elementary school named after her
item.description: Marilyn Hampton, 76, who worked as a school custodian in Texas for 39 years, has been honoured with an elementary school named after her. Hampton, who once considered herself a failure for not attending college, regularly helped students with schoolwork and bought supplies for those in need. The surprise announcement on October 21 left her in tears. The school will open in August 2027.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US river straightened 110 years ago to drain land, now set for restoration to reduce floods
item.description: Authorities in Tennessee, US, have acquired 985 acres along the South Fork of the Forked Deer River to reduce flooding and restore natural habitats. The river was straightened in 1916 to drain surrounding land, but the changes contributed to flash floods and erosion. The restoration project aims to reconnect the river with its floodplain and eventually open the area to the public.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: A new fossil from China may reveal the first amphibian known to have lived entirely at sea; the armoured, 2.4-foot creature lived about 237 million years ago, challenging what scientists know about amphibian evolution
item.description: A recent discovery of the fossil Gerrothorax maritimus reveals that some ancient amphibians lived completely in marine environments. Dated to approximately 237 million years ago, this species had a flattened body covered in bony armour. The fossils were found in deep-sea sediments, indicating they lived far from landmasses. Geochemical tests confirmed the strontium isotopes matched those in seawater during the Late Triassic period.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: Ohio couple splits before marriage, court awards woman $41,466 from house sale
item.description: An Ohio man who refused to share money from his house sale with his former partner has lost a court battle. The couple had signed an agreement in 2021 to divide the proceeds if the property was sold. After their breakup, the man argued that the woman had not spent enough on renovations. However, an appeals court upheld the agreement, awarding her $41,466.50.

item.title: Texas Supreme Court Blocks Neighbours’ Broad Demand to Inspect Woman’s 14-Acre Homestead
item.description: In a significant ruling, the Texas Supreme Court has sided with Pamela Bosco, affirming her right to keep her 14-acre homestead intact. The court denied neighbors’ requests for property inspections due to insufficient evidence of alleged violations. This ruling underscores the importance of legal processes in property disputes and confirms that establishing wrongdoing necessitates proper evidence gathering.

item.title: Atlanta Quad Meeting: Jaishankar seeks action‑oriented agenda; bloc unveils AI, minerals push
item.description: During the Quad meeting, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar highlighted the significance of preserving freedom of choice and ensuring secure supply chains. The dialogue centered around addressing non-market practices impacting the Indo-Pacific, without naming specific nations. The ministers unveiled plans to enhance access to artificial intelligence and aid critical minerals recovery while condemning issues like human trafficking and online fraud, pledging to collaboratively combat transnational crimes.

item.title: Beat LeBron, Win $100,000: MrBeast faces James, Clark, Haaland; Biles and Liu bring Olympic star power
item.description: MrBeast has brought together an extraordinary lineup of sporting superstars for his latest YouTube challenge. The video features LeBron James, Caitlin Clark, Erling Haaland, Simone Biles and Alysa Liu competing against the internet sensation in challenges inspired by their respective sports. The crossover brings together basketball, football and Olympic excellence, giving MrBeast another opportunity to create a spectacle that reaches audiences far beyond his usual YouTube fanbase.

item.title: Iran Sees US Letter As Victory: Rezaei hails softer tone as win; Khamenei warns of retaliation
item.description: Iran's influential security figure Mohsen Rezaei noted a shift in the US's approach toward Tehran, interpreting this as a triumph for the Iranian populace. In reaction, foreign minister Abbas Araghchi expressed optimism about potential negotiations, agreeing with the analysis of recent communications. Simultaneously, Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei cautioned against threats from the US or Israel, while President Trump maintained that Iran is keen to engage, hinting at an imminent meeting.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Trump speaks to Netanyahu as US weighs fresh military strikes on Iran: Report
item.description: US President Donald Trump spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu about military options against Iran while considering diplomatic negotiations. Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated ongoing talks but stressed the importance of addressing security concerns. Israeli officials have doubted Iran's willingness to abandon its nuclear program or halt missile production. The situation remains tense as military preparations are reported by US and Israeli defense forces.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: IShowSpeed's October 2026 Expedia campaign offered creators $1 per 1,000 views to repost approved livestream clips, with an $8,000 campaign budget
item.description: IShowSpeed's collaboration with Expedia provided a unique avenue for creators to monetize selected clips from their livestreams. Launched on October 14, 2026, this initiative had clear content requirements and paid creators $1 for every 1,000 views their videos garnered. With an $8,000 budget that quickly diminished, this campaign showcased fresh possibilities for revenue generation within the realm of content creation, focusing on highlights from a single livestream.

item.title: California real-estate executive sentenced for hiding debt while soliciting investments
item.description: In a significant ruling, Sanjeev Acharya, the former leader of SiliconSage Builders, will serve 18 months in prison after misleading over 20 investors about the company’s dire financial status from March to October 2020. He obtained over $2.2 million without revealing substantial debt. The court's verdict included a restitution order of over $2.25 million, highlighting the imperative for honesty in real estate investments.
